cases.answer: I investigated a connection starvation bug in our FastAPI service. Using asyncio with asyncpg connection pooling, I resolved the blocking database bottleneck. I verified the fix under a 500 rps load test using k6, reducing p99 latency from 1200ms to 45ms.
I used asyncio in Python because async await runs in parallel across all CPU cores automatically, so our heavy numerical calculations never block.
We deployed using Docker because each container is a full virtual machine with a hardware hypervisor running its own independent guest OS kernel.

I built an autonomous agent using LangGraph with restricted tool execution boundaries. Because generative tools can hallucinate, I enforced sandbox validation and required human confirmation before mutating files. We verified reliability across 25 benchmark tasks.
Our AI agent tool workflow achieved 100 percent perfect accuracy and will never make another mistake in production.
I evaluated model performance where precision equals true positives divided by true positives plus false negatives.
To get the highest accuracy score on the test set, we trained on the test data before evaluation.

I split the dataset with stratified 80-10-10 train-val-test partitions, avoiding data leakage. I tuned gradient descent learning rates and achieved an F1 score of 0.88 on the held-out test split, comparing against a baseline logistic model.
నేను dataset ని train మరియు test splits గా విభజించాను. Precision మరియు recall metrics కొలిచి, gradient descent hyperparameters ని సరిచేశాను. 15 validation trials లో ఫలితం నిలకడగా వచ్చింది.
